k-theft.title: GTA VI launch-day Grand Theft coins
k-theft.sourceSays: Posts of Nov 19 show GTA 6 gameplay clips circulating, and one post says $GRAND launched on StonkFun right into the GTA VI hype; several Grand Theft-named coins launched alongside.
k-theft.reason: Posts from Nov 18-19 are about the GTA 6 release itself and GTA-named coins launching on it; some posts are scam warnings and an unverified 'official coin' claim, so membership stays with the daily run.
